proof.criterion: Review round 5: a message whose delivery mode cannot be read leaves no attempt record, is reported exactly once, and does not stall the serving-port session
proof.surface: The listener package's real stack (natsd with JetStream, the listener's fan-out and its session relays, two serving-port sessions and a bound durable), driven by the subtest the fix added
proof.command: cd packages/envoy && GOMAXPROCS=4 GOMEMLIMIT=12GiB go test -p 1 -count=1 -v -run TestServePortRelayRefusesAnUnadvertisedModeTheFanoutAlsoRefused ./cmd/listener
proof.observed: PASS, ok 7.012s: both 'the session does not advertise the mode' (3.73s) and the new 'the mode cannot be read' (3.17s). The subtest asserts the relay acks the message, the port is pushed nothing, and the topic's exception lane carries exactly one delivery_failed for the relayed session.
proof.negativeControl: delivery.go alone restored from ce082506, every other file of this head kept: 'the mode cannot be read' FAILS, session_relay_test.go:1156, 'the consumer of ses_mode_relayed_… has 1 pending ack, ack floor 0; want 0 pending and everything through 1 acked', while 'the session does not advertise the mode' still PASSes. That is the regression review round 5 found, reproduced by me, and it names the fan-out's single decision as the cause rather than anything else of this round.

proof.criterion: The harm the subtest does not measure: the session's LATER messages arrive, rather than waiting out attemptCacheTTL behind the refused one
proof.surface: The same real stack: a serving-port session on consumer delivery, an unreadable-mode message stored first, an ordinary message on the same topic stored behind it, the relay started only after the fan-out has decided both
proof.command: A scratch test of mine in cmd/listener, not committed: TestScratchUnreadableModeDoesNotStallLaterMessages
proof.observed: PASS, 2.46s. The later message reaches the port within seconds of the relay starting, and the exception lane carries exactly one delivery_failed. I wrote it because the committed subtest proves the stream is not stalled (0 pending, ack floor past the message) and not that a later message is delivered, which is the promise this issue is about.
proof.negativeControl: The same delivery.go restored from ce082506: FAIL after 30 s, 'the later message ce35e164… never reached the port: the unreadable-mode message before it stalled the session'. Thirty seconds is my bound; the real wait there is attemptCacheTTL, five minutes. So the fix is worth what it says it is worth, measured end to end rather than inferred from an ack floor.
